metadata.title: छत्तीसगढ़ का सुवा नाच। छेरछेरा त्यौहार । Suwa Dance of Chhattisgarh Adivasis । Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
This Episode of Main Bhi Bharat takes you to a small village in Korba District of Chhattisgarh, where we meet Kanwar Adivasis. Lafagarh is a village, which has a population of Kanwar, Tanwar and Gond adivasis. These Adivasis celebrate the Cherchera festival in the month of January, and perform the Suwa Dance.

For updates regarding upcoming videos and stories follows our social media accounts linked below::
